Workflows.title: Search and Filter Photos
Workflows.goal: Search for a specific topic and apply filters to narrow results. Success: Filtered results are displayed.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Type 'office' into the main search input field
3. Press Enter
4. Click the 'Orientation' filter dropdown and select 'Landscape'
5. Click the 'Color' filter dropdown and select 'Black and white'
6. Verify that the photo grid updates to show matching results.

Workflows.title: Download Free Photo
Workflows.goal: Find a free photo and trigger the download. Success: Download starts and 'Say thanks' modal appears.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Click on any photo in the editorial feed to open the modal
3. Click the 'Download free' button in the top right corner of the modal
4. Verify that the browser triggers a file download
5. Verify that the 'Say thanks' attribution modal appears.

Workflows.title: Unsplash+ Subscription Entry
Workflows.goal: Navigate to the Unsplash+ landing page and initiate the subscription flow. Success: User reaches the plan selection or login page.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Click 'Unsplash+' in the top navigation bar
3. Click the 'Get Unsplash+' button on the landing page
4. Verify that the user is prompted to sign up or select a subscription plan.

Workflows.title: API Documentation and Service Status
Workflows.goal: Navigate the developer portal to find specific API documentation and check system health. Success: Documentation and status page are visible.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click 'View the documentation'
3. Click 'Search photos' in the left sidebar to view endpoint details
4. Navigate back to the Developer home and click 'API Status' in the footer
5. Verify that https://status.unsplash.com/ shows 'All Systems Operational'.

Workflows.title: Help Center Keyword Search
Workflows.goal: Search for licensing information in the help center. Success: Relevant article is found and displayed.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://help.unsplash.com/en/
2. Type 'license' into the 'Search for articles...' input field
3. Press Enter
4. Click on the article titled 'What is the Unsplash+ License'
5. Verify the article content loads and click the 'All Collections' breadcrumb to return.

Workflows.title: Download Lite Dataset
Workflows.goal: Access the Unsplash dataset page and download the Lite version. Success: Download of the 1.5GB zip file is triggered.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/data
2. Scroll down to the 'Lite' dataset section
3. Click the 'Download' button
4. Verify that the browser starts downloading 'unsplash-research-dataset-lite-latest.zip'.

Workflows.title: Blog Category Filtering and Article Sharing
Workflows.goal: Filter blog posts by category and share an article on social media. Success: Filtered list is shown and share intent is triggered.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/blog/
2. Click the 'Announcements' category link in the header
3. Click on the 'Unsplash Awards 2025 Selections' article
4. Scroll to the bottom of the article and click the Twitter/X share icon
5. Verify that a new tab opens with the Twitter share interface.
